If Data Centers and Battery Storage System Warehouses are SO beneficial to the communities, then why do they always either have to lie or try to sneak it under the radar as communities all over the country are opposing them coming into their communities? Say no to corrupt politicians who are willing to make millions off of our communities and lives. #datacenter #sgv #sangabrielvalley #noai #altadena

Please help find Ben Barbante and bring him home to his family. It seems he has left Spain and most likely went to Railay Beach, Thailand next, but we do not have confirmation that he boarded his flight from Madrid to Bangkok on Oct 21 as he was scheduled to but based off the message he sent his friend, it seems he is in Thailand. Pls help make sure this video reaches Thailand and help bring Ben home! #benbarbante #missing #thailand #railaybeach #missingperson

I have never been so excited to see a movie before in my life bc even tho I’m not Filipino, an authentic story of what it means to work hard to not lose your cultural identity make me feel so seen. Can’t wait. #forgottenisland #dreamworks #leasolonga #her #filipino

Replying to @Ed Well, if it isn’t the consequences of your own actions, John F Mann (and hello to you too Nate Mann)! Oh did you think that because the cops didn’t arrest you that day that you escaped accountability?! No, John, the Find Out stage of FAFO has just begun! Enjoy! #johnmann #fafo #consequences #natemann #carlsbad

When I was 9, I looked up to that counselor bc I had never had that much positive attention- someone telling me how funny and smart and great I was - esp from a male figure. And for YEARS I thought so highly of him, until I looked at it through the lens and playing back all the times he brought up my speedo to “tease” me, and all the funny jokes were really just cr33py comments bc he was gr00ming me. So no, I don’t care about legalities, you do not film children without consent bc YOU are the ad

Imagine thinking that saying that your 62yo father was cr33pily filming a 16yo CHILD bc he wanted his 31yo son to ask her out is going to make you look good. 🥴🤢 But I guess that’s on par for the son of a man who said “filming in public isn’t illegal” when confronted with filming a CHILD and trying to follow her to school (allegedly) #johnmann #natemann #carlsbad #consequences #thisyou
